content: When the coordinated shutdown is started, a shutdown de- lay timer shall be activated for each currently awake channel in the coordination clus- ter. Each timer shall be set to NmGlobalCoordinatorTime . In case NmBusType is not set to NM_BUSNM_LOCALNM additionally the shutdown time of the specific channel TSHUTDOWN_CHANNEL shall be subtracted.
